comment: Initial load counts the app entry and every transitive static JavaScript import, plus CSS. Lazy counts chunks reached only by dynamic imports, including the terminal, passkey credential helpers and account settings. The previous check counted static shared chunks as lazy and missed them from initial, so these caps match the built asset graph. Sizes are bytes; gzip level 9 approximates a compressing proxy. The UX status skeleton adds under 200 raw bytes and reduced the latest five-run Pixel 4 CLS max from 0.409 to 0.000. Deferring account settings and passkey helpers keeps initial JavaScript under its existing caps. Passkey IP-origin detection and unavailable-address guidance measured 361138 raw lazy JS. API-009 worker-bound token selection adds account settings code. SEC2-014's new-device sign-in notice and immediate refresh after password or passkey login measure 31406 initial JS gzip bytes versus 31000 before. SEC2-008 active-session review/revocation and SEC2-013 cursor-paged security activity are in the consolidated account chunk. That chunk set measures 376680 raw / 101373 gzip; the lazy caps are 377000 raw / 102000 gzip to retain the initial-load boundary with under 0.7% raw headroom (DECISIONS.md D28). The password-reset hint, notice and forced password change (PRD-036) raised the initial JavaScript caps to 91000 raw / 31750 gzip; moving workers, sessions and usage views out of the first load keeps initial caps unchanged (D17).
